creative_direction: Construct a small architectural emblem from a cobalt staircase, an ocher circular opening, and an ivory platform. View the structure in a restrained axonometric angle so the steps climb diagonally into the circle without a visible destination. Use only flat planes and one deep blue shadow, keeping the geometry precise but not crowded. Center the assembly on a warm white square with generous blank space. The circular opening is solidly built into a short wall, not a floating sun pasted behind it. Let the stairs cast one clean shadow across the platform. No people, railings, signage, or decorative objects; the unusual spatial connection should carry the image.
